svg.aria-label: ID525 API coverage: 80 of 100 features implemented
svg.text: 80 of 100 UI features implemented · every square is one page or API endpoint of the router web UI

g.title: New CSRF token (token_query): live-verified, session → client.keep_alive
Reset data counters (never called) (data_status): dead-code, write
Router / bridge mode (req_LanOperationModeSave): ui-captured, destructive → client.cellular.set_operation_mode
Select default APN (req_defaultApnSave): ui-captured, write → client.cellular.set_default_apn
Ethernet WAN port (req_ethWanEnabled): ui-captured, destructive → client.lan.set_ethernet_port_role
Add DHCP reservation (req_LanStaticAddrAdd): ui-captured, write → client.lan.add_dhcp_reservation
Edit DHCP reservation (req_LanStaticAddrModify): ui-captured, write → client.lan.modify_dhcp_reservation
Delete DHCP reservation (req_LanStaticAddrDelete): ui-captured, write → client.lan.delete_dhcp_reservation
Add IP rule (ipfilter_add): ui-captured, write → client.ip_filter.add_rule
Edit IP rule (ipfilter_edit): ui-captured-synthetic, write → client.ip_filter.edit_rule
Rename client (UI code broken) (set_host_name): dead-code, write
Port forwarding on/off (set_portforward_status): ui-captured, write → client.port_forwarding.disable
URL filter on/off (urlfilter_status_save): ui-captured, write → client.url_filter.set_filter
Change admin password (set_account_management): ui-captured, destructive → client.account.change_password
Reset data usage (reset_data): ui-captured, destructive → client.account.reset_data_usage
Data usage settings (data_usage_save): ui-captured, write → client.account.set_data_limit
Mark SMS read (req_smsUpdateStatus): ui-captured-synthetic, write → client.sms.mark_read
Ask the operator for firmware (UI button disabled) (acs_check_update): ui-captured, action → client.software.check_for_update
Firmware check progress (acs_check_update_status): ui-captured, action → client.software.check_for_update
Install operator firmware (acs_update_confirm): stub-unsafe, destructive → client.software.install_operator_update
Upload firmware / config file (upload_file): stub-unsafe, destructive → client.software.upgrade_firmware
Create config backup (hidden) (bkupConfig_apply): stub-unknown, action → client.system.backup_config
Restore config backup (restoreCofig_apply): stub-unsafe, destructive → client.system.restore_config
